title: Journal of Keady and District

title: Journal of Keady and District
author: Keady Historical Society
content: I will name a few who, though not active members deserve mention for other reasons: Dr. Eric and Mrs. Dorman who attended most of our functions and outings, Rev. Mr. Nealy, Rector of Keady Church of Ireland who always made Tommy O’Reilly welcome when he called in search of information, Very Reverend, the late Canon Peter Moore, who put the writings of Fr. McDermot at the disposal of Fr. Raymond Murray to give a talk in the hall, also, for use of Parochial Hall before the Community Centre was built, Paddy Hamill Chairman of Armagh Historical Society who showed us around Navan Fort or the Fort of Ard Macha, Fr. P. Campbell a former Secretary of Armagh Historical Society who came to some of our functions and gave us help and advice, Reverend Wm. Cameron, Minister of First Keady Presbyterian Church (The Temple) and Armaghbreage Presbyterian Church, and his good lady who graced some of our functions by their presence.

title: Journal of Keady and District
